name: Hittites
overview: The Hittites, descendants of Heth and part of the Canaanite tribes, are notably mentioned in Scripture as the people dwelling in Hebron who interacted with Abraham. They are recorded as selling Abraham a burial site in the field of Machpelah, which became the family burial ground, demonstrating a significant covenantal transaction between the patriarch and the local inhabitants. This interaction highlights the historical reality of the Hittites as established inhabitants of the land promised to Abraham's descendants, setting the stage for their later involvement with Israel.
